name: Net Mender
rules: Heal 1 damage from a card each round.

name: Salt Sentinel
rules: Cannot be damaged by Fog events.

name: Wave Rider
rules: Fast. Can move to any place.

name: Tide Caller
rules: Flip at round end. Rising: draw two cards.

name: Ebb Caller
rules: Flip at round end. Ebbing: put a card from hand on the deck.

name: Undertow
rules: Return a Fog creature to the Fog deck.

name: Current Step
rules: Move a keeper to any place.

name: Pearl Ward
rules: A keeper takes no damage until your next turn.
